query :: Int -> Maybe [(Int,Int)]
query n
  | n == highestBit = Nothing
  | n == 3 = Just $ fromSeq [1,2,3,4,5,6]
  | odd n = Just $ fromSeq ([1..highestBit-1] ++ [n+1..n+highestBit-1]) ++
            fromSeq ([highestBit..n]
                     ++ if xorAll == 0 then [1] else [xorAll]) ++
            fromSeq ((if xorAll == 0 then highestBit-1 else xorAll)
                     : [n+highestBit..n+n])
  | otherwise = Just $ fromSeq (ls ++ map (n+) ls) ++
                fromSeq ([highestBit..n-1] ++ [addendumForN]) ++
                fromSeq (connNpH1:[n+highestBit..n+n-1])++
                fromSeq [n,n-1] ++
                fromSeq [addendumForN,n+n]
  where
    highestIndex = finiteBitSize (0::Int) - countLeadingZeros n - 1
    highestBit = bit highestIndex
    xorAll = foldl' xor 0 [highestBit..n]
    xorAllButN = foldl' xor 0 [highestBit..n-1]
    addendumForN = (n-1) `xor` n
    addendumForLessThanN = addendumForN `xor` xorAllButN
    {-# INLINE CONLIKE ls #-}
    ls =  [i | i <-[1..highestBit-1], addendumForN /= i,
          addendumForLessThanN /= i] ++
         addendumForN:
         if addendumForLessThanN == 0 || xorAllButN == 0
          then [] else [addendumForLessThanN]
    connNpH1 | addendumForLessThanN == 0 = addendumForN
             | xorAllButN == 0
                 = n+ head [ i | i <- [highestBit-1,highestBit-2..1],
                                 i /= addendumForN]
             | otherwise                 = addendumForLessThanN

query :: Int -> Maybe [(Int,Int)]
query n
  | n == highestBit = Nothing
  | n == 3 = Just $ fromSeq [1,2,3,4,5,6]
  | odd n = Just $ fromSeq ([1..highestBit-1] ++ [n+1..n+highestBit-1]) ++
            fromSeq ([highestBit..n]
                     ++ if xorAll == 0 then [1] else [xorAll]) ++
            fromSeq ((if xorAll == 0 then highestBit-1 else xorAll)
                     : [n+highestBit..n+n])
  | otherwise = Just $ fromSeq (ls ++ map (n+) ls) ++
                fromSeq ([highestBit..n-1] ++ [addendumForN]) ++
                fromSeq (connNpH1:[n+highestBit..n+n-1])++
                fromSeq [n,n-1] ++
                fromSeq [addendumForN,n+n]
  where
    highestIndex = finiteBitSize (0::Int) - countLeadingZeros n - 1
    highestBit = bit highestIndex
    xorAll = foldl' xor 0 [highestBit..n]
    xorAllButN = foldl' xor 0 [highestBit..n-1]
    addendumForN = (n-1) `xor` n
    addendumForLessThanN = addendumForN `xor` xorAllButN
    {-# INLINE CONLIKE ls #-}
    ls = [i | i <-[1..highestBit-1], addendumForN /= i,
          addendumForLessThanN /= i] ++
         addendumForN:
         if addendumForLessThanN == 0 then [] else [addendumForLessThanN]
    connNpH1 | addendumForLessThanN == 0 = addendumForN
             | otherwise                 = addendumForLessThanN

;; NOT TESTED
(defun make-random-tree (size)
  "Returns an undirected random tree of the given size."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) size))
  (let ((graph (make-array size :element-type 'list :initial-element nil))
        (dset (make-array size :element-type 'fixnum :initial-element -1))
        (count 0))
    (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) count))
    ;; Union-Find
    (labels ((ds-root (x)
               (if (< (aref dset x) 0)
                   x
                   (setf (aref dset x)
                         (ds-root (aref dset x)))))
             (ds-unite (x1 x2)
               (let ((root1 (ds-root x1))
                     (root2 (ds-root x2)))
                 (unless (= root1 root2)
                   (when (> (aref dset root1) (aref dset root2))
                     (rotatef root1 root2))
                   (incf (aref dset root1) (aref dset root2))
                   (setf (aref dset root2) root1)))))
      (loop until (= count (- size 1))
            for u = (random size)
            for v = (random size)
            unless (= (ds-root u) (ds-root v))
            do (ds-unite u v)
               (push u (aref graph v))
               (push v (aref graph u))
               (incf count)))
    graph))

(defun skolem-p (graph)
  (declare #.OPT
           ((simple-array list (*)) graph))
  (let ((n (floor (length graph) 2)))
    (declare (uint31 n))
    (labels ((dfs (v parent dest xor)
               (declare (uint31 v parent dest xor))
               (when (= v dest)
                 (if (zerop xor)
                     (return-from dfs t)
                     (return-from skolem-p nil)))
               (dolist (child (aref graph v))
                 (declare (uint31 child))
                 (unless (= child parent)
                   (when (dfs child v dest (logxor xor (+ (mod child n) 1)))
                     (return t))))))
      (dotimes (v n t)
        (dfs v (* 2 n) (+ v n) 0)))))

(defun random-search (n)
  (loop repeat 10000000000
        for graph = (make-random-tree (* 2 n))
        when (skolem-p graph)
        do (format t "~D ~D~%" (* 2 n) (- (* 2 n) 1))
           (dotimes (u (* 2 n))
                (dolist (v (aref graph u))
                  (when (< u v)
                    (format t "~D ~D~%" (+ u 1) (+ v 1)))))
           (return graph)))
